recent.health_basis: NOT A MEASUREMENT - no call was observed in the immune window, so 1.0 is the absence of failures and not a reading of anything
recent.steps_failed_basis: steps attempted on this beat that raised, by name, cleared at the start of every beat so a failure never outlives the beat that had it. They are deliberately NOT in `actions`: an action is something the beat performed. Since W611 (FU-461) EVERY beat step's failure is recorded here, so an EMPTY steps_failed means no step raised. That includes a step that CAUGHT its own error and reports it in a field of its own (the four homeostatic responders, the cadence, the two reconciliations and the metabolic cycle): each is recorded here as well. One thing is not a step failure and is not here: a single unreadable ship record skipped while looking for stale bodies.

heartbeat.metabolic_basis: the metabolic cycle has not run on this process, so there is no outcome to report — the loop is paced and OFF by default, and this is not a withheld emission
heartbeat.note: Continuous circadian autonomy — cheap pulse every beat; expensive cognition opt-in + paced.

immune_health.basis: no call was observed in the sensor's window - this value is the absence of failures, not a measurement

self_healing_health.basis: no circuits tracked yet — defaulted to 1.0, not a measurement

metabolic.basis: ATPSimulator on a constant metabolic_load — simulated, not a measurement of this platform

organism.composite_health_basis: 0% of this figure's weight is measured (nothing); the rest is an immune term with NO call observed in its window (the absence of failures, not a reading), a self-healing term defaulted to 1.0 and a simulated metabolic term. The measured-only score is None, and that is what decides the mode and every gate.
organism.mode_basis: THE DEFAULT - nothing was measured in the last 5 minutes (no call observed, no circuit tracked), so this mode is not an assessment (0% of the blend's weight is measured). The blended figure 0.872 also carries a self-healing term defaulted to 1.0 and a simulated metabolic term, so it cannot be read as a measurement.
organism.mode_decidable_basis: NOTHING is measured: no call was observed in the immune sensor's window and no circuit is tracked. The measured-only score is None, so every gate that tests it HOLDS for an explicit decision; the mode shown is the default.
organism.measured_weight_basis: 0% of the blend's weight is measured; no circuit is tracked yet, so self-healing is a default rather than a reading, and the metabolic term is a simulation. This is the confidence behind the figure, not a rule about who may decide.
organism.health_summary: Nothing was measured in the last 5 minutes: no call was observed and no circuit is tracked. The mode shown (NOMINAL) is the default, not an assessment; health-gated changes are held for an explicit decision.

immune.observed_basis: NO call was observed in the last 5 minutes, so the health figure is the absence of failures and not a reading of anything
immune.health_basis: health and threat are computed from 0 failure(s) in the window; 0 compliance review flag(s) are reported beside them and are NOT counted — a flag asks a human to look, it is not a finding of harm

metabolic.basis: the metabolic term is an ATPSimulator on a load clamped to its declared 0-1 domain, where production (0.5 x efficiency, efficiency 0.8 or 1.0) always exceeds consumption (0.1 x load), so within that domain it only rises — from 0.333 at boot to 1.0 — and the thresholds written against it cannot fire. It is a simulation, not a reading of this platform's energy.
metabolic.energy_basis: 1 - 0.0s spent / 3600s stated capacity this window (the capacity is a stated assumption); the work budget is switched off (WORKSTATION_WORK_BUDGET), so nothing reads this figure: the energy thresholds read the ATP simulator, which cannot fall, and stay inert as ruled

work_budget.unit: wall-clock seconds of recorded run time
work_budget.fraction_basis: seconds_spent / capacity_seconds, SECONDS ALONE: tokens are recorded beside it but no token capacity is stated, so tokens do not enter the fraction and cannot hold anything
work_budget.tokens_basis: NOT RECORDED — no run this window reported a token count (a count comes only from a model's own answer; the deterministic floor runs no model), so this is null rather than 0; zero would read as 'no tokens were used' when nobody counted
work_budget.capacity_basis: 3600 seconds per 6-hour window is a STATED ASSUMPTION, not a measurement — nothing here has yet measured what this platform's sustainable rate is

consumers.native homeostasis admission: while the gate holds, the native tree and the org cascade run their nodes one at a time; single model calls, deliverables and every other AI door are not held, and no run is refused or deferred

work_budget.gate_basis: it GATES NOTHING: the budget ships inert until WORKSTATION_WORK_BUDGET=true, per the Owner's ruling
work_budget.spend_basis: the sum of the run durations the platform recorded, each nest counted once (W847): a run recorded inside a marked run (a model attempt inside the AI call that made it; an AI call inside a deliverable, a composition, a swarm, a cascade tier, the board or a transformation) is held by the outermost run, which spends its own duration with the tokens its inner runs counted. A run made where the mark does not reach (a worker thread started without it) can still be counted at two levels. Durations a caller reported through /api/v1/operations/record are not counted
work_budget.basis: 0.0s of a stated 3600s capacity is recorded spent this window, from 0 run(s) whose duration was measured — and it GATES NOTHING: the budget ships inert until WORKSTATION_WORK_BUDGET=true, per the Owner's ruling

entities.basis: 0.0s of the 0.0s recorded this window came from runs that named the owner they ran for; the rest named none, so it counts in the platform total and is apportioned to no one. These figures are reported, not enforced: the S18.1 gate (gate()) reads the platform total, not an entity's own figure

carrying_capacity.basis: UNMEASURED - no run this window was attributed to an entity, so no per-entity demand is measured and no carrying capacity is derived; it is never set by hand

reconfiguration.wiring_basis: These are stored switches. 0 of 9 feature flag(s) and 0 of 6 domain flag(s) are read by anything, so switching any other one changes nothing. The provider preference is stored only - nothing reads it; the RPM limit is read by: ai.gateway rate limiter (re-synced ~30s via _sync_reconfig). The per-key table is on the Anatomy tab.

lifecycle.pipeline_health_basis: FLOURISHING: >30% commercialised · GROWING: any project touched in 30 days (1 were) · STATIC: projects exist but idle · DORMANT: none

vsb.operational_basis: counts status == 'operating', which is what _derived_status returns today (0 entit(ies)), plus 0 written by pre-W496 paths that still carry ['operational', 'active'] on disk. Statuses NOT counted as operating: none
